lines.text: Eleazar, Joshua, and the family heads assigned land by lot to nine and a half tribes, as the LORD commanded.
Caleb told Joshua at Gilgal he was forty when Moses sent him from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land.
Caleb stayed loyal to the LORD, Moses swore him the land, and Caleb was now ninety years old.
Caleb said he was still strong, and he asked for the hill country with great, fortified cities.
Joshua blessed Caleb and gave him Hebron, once called Kiriath-arba after Arba, the greatest man among the Philistines.
